fullPassage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.

❌ ④ distinct: distinct(뚜렷이 다른)는 different와 유사한 의미
det.tip: different(다른) ↔ identical(동일한)

questions.passage:
(A) In my <u>view</u>, the new plan will benefit everyone in the long run.
(B) So to find one in full <u>view</u> in the shallows in daylight was a surprise.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 view의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: view: (A) 나의 견해/의견 / (B) 눈에 보이는 상태(시야)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 시야 — (B) 견해/의견: (A)는 '견해', (B)는 '시야'로 서로 바뀜
❌ ② (A) 견해/의견 — (B) 바라보다: (B)의 view는 동사 '바라보다'가 아니라 명사 '시야'
✅ ③ (A) 견해/의견 — (B) 시야(눈에 보임): (A)는 'In my view'로 '내 견해로는', (B)는 'in full view'로 '훤히 보이는 상태'를 뜻해 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 풍경 — (B) 검토하다: (A)는 '견해'이지 '풍경'이 아님
det.tip: view: ① 견해/의견 (in my view) ② 시야/보이는 상태 (in full view)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to see; the power of sight"

det.korean: eyesight=시력 (볼 수 있는 능력)
det.analysis:
❌ ① pattern: pattern(무늬)은 시력이 아닌 모양
❌ ② illusion: illusion(착시)은 잘못된 지각이지 시력 자체가 아님
❌ ③ defence: defence(방어)는 보는 능력과 무관
✅ ④ eyesight: eyesight(시력)는 볼 수 있는 능력으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: eyesight = 시력. the ability to see가 핵심

questions.passage: An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was __________ (use) these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: use → using: 'was + V-ing'의 과거진행형
det.analysis: 'this one was __________ (use) these assets'에서 be동사 was 뒤에 현재분사가 와서 과거진행형(was using)을 이룬다. 문어가 능력을 '사용하고 있던' 진행 의미이므로 using이 적절하다. use → using
det.tip: was + V-ing = 과거진행형. was using these assets

questions.passage: It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms __________ (fold) and its two eyes staring upwards.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: fold → folded: 'with + 명사 + 과거분사' 구문으로, 팔이 '접힌' 수동 관계
det.analysis: 'with all eight of its arms __________ (fold)'는 'with + 명사 + 분사' 부대상황 구문이다. 팔(arms)이 '접힌' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 folded가 필요하다. fold → folded
det.tip: with + 명사 + 과거분사 = ~이 …된 채로. with its arms folded(팔이 접힌 채)

questions.passage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to __________ as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: stay hidden=숨어 지내다 — 문어의 최선의 방어는 가능한 한 숨어 지내는 것이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① stay hidden: 원문 일치. 대부분의 문어 종에게 최선의 방어는 가능한 한 숨어 지내는(stay hidden) 것이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② show off: show off(과시하다)는 숨어 지낸다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ give up: give up(포기하다)은 방어 전략과 무관
❌ ④ swim fast: swim fast(빠르게 헤엄치다)는 본문이 말한 방어(숨기)와 다름
det.tip: The best defence ... is to stay hidden as much as possible (숨어 지내다)
